nodes.text: The road speaks well of you, which is rarer than you would think, the road mostly complains. So: the hand. Ferrick vouches, I seal, and you wear Company red where it counts. Fair warning in ink: the charter towns and the Crown will think less of your name for it. They keep ledgers too.

choices.text: Get me the voucher. I want the colors.

nodes.text: The Tollhouse, first climb on the High Road. Tell Ferrick the chair sent you and watch him pretend not to be pleased.
Sensible. The offer keeps. The Company is patient the way winter is patient.
